disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Real activity is unusually strong and broad: congressional net buying is 2.669, lobbying is 2.911, material 8-K events are 1.131, and the regulatory pipeline is 0.67, producing fused acceleration of 4.143 across four sources [P3]. Persistence looks credible because the signal spans four independent channels, although the theme is still forming and the absence of a news leg limits confirmation [P1][P5]. Price has not yet followed: 60-day relative strength is -9.41% with neutral direction, while activity leads price by 2.264 [P2][P4]. This supports ENTER, but only with medium confidence because the signal is early and has no news confirmation [P1][P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号强且来源广泛：国会净买入为2.669，游说升温为2.911，重大8-K事件为1.131，监管管线为0.67，四个来源共同形成4.143的加速读数[P3]。四条独立渠道同时增强，说明持续性较可信，但主题仍处于形成阶段，且没有新闻端配合，因此确认度有限[P1][P5]。价格尚未跟上：过去60天相对大盘落后9.41%，方向中性，而活动领先价格2.264[P2][P4]。因此判断为ENTER，但由于信号尚早且缺少新闻确认，置信度为中等[P1][P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-related buying, lobbying, corporate disclosures, and regulatory activity are all strengthening at the same time. Prices have not followed yet, trailing the market by about 9% over 60 days, so the opportunity appears early rather than fully priced. A position is warranted, but with moderate conviction because the pickup is still developing and has no supporting news flow.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府相关买入、游说活动、企业重大披露和监管动向正在同步增强。相关资产过去60天落后大盘约9%，价格尚未反映这些变化，因此机会看起来仍处于早期。可以考虑建仓，但应保持适度信心，因为这轮升温仍在发展中，也缺少新闻面的配合。
assessments.dissent: The strongest opposing case is that the apparent surge is premature: the theme is only forming, regulatory activity is comparatively modest, price direction remains neutral despite 60-day underperformance, and there is no news leg [P1][P3][P4][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm if the next observation retains strength across multiple activity sources and the covered members begin outperforming the market, closing the current activity-price gap [P2][P3][P4][P6].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm if congressional buying and lobbying activity fall back without price improvement, leaving the signal dependent on weaker corporate-event or regulatory inputs while news remains absent [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Memory, HBM & Storage

assessments.rationale: Real activity is strong: congressional net buying is exceptionally elevated (z=3.5) and lobbying is also ramping (z=2.321), producing fused acceleration of 2.619 across three sources [P3]. Persistence is plausible but not yet proven because the theme is still forming [P1], material 8-K events are weak (z=-0.83) [P3], and there is no supporting news leg [P5]. Price has not confirmed the activity: 60-day relative performance is -5.4% versus SPY [P4], while the activity-price divergence is strongly positive at 1.875 [P2]. That gap supports ENTER before price catches up, but the mixed source signal and absent news confirmation keep confidence at MED [P3][P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号较强：国会议员净买入显著升高（z=3.5），游说活动也在加速（z=2.321），三个来源合成后的加速度达到2.619 [P3]。持续性尚未完全确认，因为主题仍处于形成阶段 [P1]，重大8-K事件信号偏弱（z=-0.83）[P3]，且没有新闻面的配合 [P5]。价格尚未确认这些变化：过去60天相对大盘落后5.4% [P4]，而现实活动领先价格的偏离度为1.875 [P2]。因此可在价格追赶前进入，但来源之间存在分歧且缺少新闻确认，信心为中等 [P3][P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Congressional buying and lobbying activity around payments and financial-technology companies have risen sharply, but corporate event filings remain soft and there is no supporting news wave. Prices have lagged the market by about 5.4% over the past 60 days, so investors have not yet followed the activity. A measured entry is warranted before a possible catch-up, though the mixed signals argue against taking an oversized position.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 围绕支付和金融科技公司的国会议员买入与游说活动明显升温，但企业重大事项披露仍偏弱，也没有形成新闻热潮。相关公司过去60天的表现比大盘落后约5.4%，说明投资者尚未跟上这些现实变化。可以考虑适度提前布局，但信号并不完全一致，不宜重仓。
assessments.dissent: The strongest opposing case is that the signal may reflect two policy-related bursts rather than durable business momentum: material 8-K activity is negative and no news leg is present [P3][P5], while price has shown no confirming direction and has underperformed the market over 60 days [P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Over the next observation window, lobbying and congressional-buying signals remain positive or broaden further, 8-K activity turns positive, and the covered companies begin outperforming the market [P3][P4][P6].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The congressional-buying or lobbying signals fall back toward neutral without improvement in 8-K events, while the covered companies continue underperforming the market [P3][P4][P6].

assessments.name: Payments & Fintech

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully positive but uneven: federal grants/loans (z=3.5), lobbying (z=2.658), and 8-K material events (z=2.029) drive fused acceleration of 1.805 across nine sources [P3]. Persistence is uncertain because federal contracts, grant opportunities, pre-award solicitations, congressional buying, and news flow are all negative [P3], while news acceleration is also falling [P5]. Price has not confirmed the activity: 60-day relative strength is -13.98% versus the market [P4], producing an activity-over-price divergence of 1.305 in a still-forming setup [P1][P2]. Monitor for the strong signals to spread into contracts and forward procurement activity before entering.
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号明显但并不均衡：联邦拨款与贷款、游说活动和重大公司事件较强，推动九个来源的综合加速度达到1.805 [P3]。持续性仍有疑问，因为联邦合同、拨款机会、招标前采购、国会净买入和新闻流均偏弱，新闻加速度也在下降 [P3][P5]。价格尚未确认，过去60天相对大盘落后13.98%，现实活动领先价格的差值为1.305，且趋势仍处于形成阶段 [P1][P2][P4]。在强势信号扩散到合同和前期采购活动之前，宜继续观察。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government funding, lobbying and company-reported material events are picking up, but actual contracts, future funding opportunities and early procurement activity remain weak. Prices have lagged the market by nearly 14% over the past 60 days, so investors have not yet validated the improving activity. Keep watching for the funding and lobbying surge to translate into contracts and procurement before committing capital.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府资金、游说活动和企业披露的重大事项正在升温，但实际合同、未来资金机会和前期采购活动仍然疲弱。相关公司的价格过去60天落后大盘近14%，说明投资者尚未认可这些改善。应继续观察资金和游说热度能否转化为合同与采购，再考虑投入资金。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish case is that grants/loans, lobbying, and material corporate events are already surging while price remains weak, creating an unusually favorable early entry before broader confirmation [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the thesis if the next observation shows federal contracts, pre-award solicitations, and grant opportunities turning positive while fused activity acceleration remains positive and relative performance stops deteriorating.
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the thesis if grants/loans, lobbying, or material-event activity falls back toward neutral or negative while contracts and solicitations remain weak and relative performance continues to decline.

assessments.name: Defense & Aerospace

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price: the divergence is positive at 0.768 and the theme is still emerging [P1][P2]. The signal spans seven sources with strong readings in pre-award solicitations (1.619), lobbying (1.445), and the regulatory pipeline (1.429), while news flow is also positive (0.674) and accelerating [P3][P5]. Durability is not yet conclusive because congressional buying is negative (-0.96), and material 8-K events (0.11) and federal grant opportunities (0.196) remain weak [P3]. Price has not confirmed the activity: 60-day relative strength versus the market is -7.34%, supporting continued monitoring rather than immediate entry [P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 实体活动明显领先于价格：背离读数为正的0.768，主题仍处于早期阶段 [P1][P2]。七类来源中，招标前采购意向（1.619）、游说活动（1.445）和监管管线（1.429）最强，新闻流也为正且正在加速 [P3][P5]。但持续性尚未得到充分确认，因为国会议员净买入为负（-0.96），重大8-K事件（0.11）和联邦资助机会（0.196）仍弱 [P3]。过去60天相对大盘表现为-7.34%，价格尚未确认这些活动，因此目前更适合观察 [P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Procurement preparations, lobbying, regulatory activity, and news attention are picking up across semiconductor-equipment companies, but company disclosures and grant opportunities remain subdued. Share prices have lagged the market by about 7% over the past 60 days, so investors have not yet validated the improving real-world signals. Keep the group on a watchlist and wait for either stronger corporate activity or a sustained price response before committing capital.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 半导体设备公司的采购准备、游说、监管活动和新闻关注度正在上升，但公司重大披露和政府资助机会仍然偏弱。相关股票过去60天落后大盘约7%，说明投资者尚未认可这些改善。现阶段宜继续观察，等待企业活动进一步增强或股价出现持续回应后再考虑投入资金。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that three forward-looking channels—pre-award solicitations, lobbying, and regulatory activity—are simultaneously strong, while news is accelerating; with activity already ahead of price, the current weakness could represent an attractive early entry rather than a reason to wait [P2][P3][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the thesis if the next observation shows pre-award solicitations, lobbying, and regulatory activity remaining positive while weak channels such as 8-K events or grant opportunities strengthen, alongside improving relative price performance [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the thesis if the leading activity channels roll over, news acceleration fades, and relative performance remains negative or deteriorates, indicating that the current divergence was temporary [P2][P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
assessments.name_zh: 半导体设备（晶圆厂设备）

assessments.rationale: Real activity is modestly ahead of price, with a divergence z of 0.312 and strong fused acceleration of 1.757 across seven sources [P2][P3]. However, the signal is uneven: lobbying is strong at z=1.497, while material events, grant opportunities, congressional buying, and news flow are negative; contracts and solicitations are only slightly positive [P3]. Persistence is uncertain because the theme is still forming, news acceleration is negative, and 60-day relative strength trails SPY [P1][P4][P5]. This supports monitoring rather than entry until activity broadens beyond lobbying or price begins to confirm [P3][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动相对价格略有领先，背离值为0.312，七类来源的综合加速度达到1.757 [P2][P3]。但信号分化明显：游说活动较强，读数为1.497；重大事项、联邦资助机会、国会净买入和新闻流均为负，合同与招标仅略为正 [P3]。主题仍处于形成阶段，新闻加速度为负，过去60天的相对表现也落后于大盘，因此持续性和价格确认都不足 [P1][P4][P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Space-related commercial and government activity appears to be picking up slightly ahead of share prices, but most of the improvement comes from increased lobbying rather than contracts, grants, corporate events, or news. Prices have lagged the market over the past 60 days, while news momentum is slowing. Keep the theme on a watchlist and wait for broader real-world activity or a clear improvement in price before committing capital.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 航天相关的商业和政府活动似乎略微领先于股价回升，但目前的改善主要来自游说增加，而不是合同、资助机会、企业重大事项或新闻热度。相关股票过去60天落后于大盘，新闻热度也在减速。现阶段更适合继续观察，等待现实活动扩大到更多领域，或价格走势明确转强后再投入资金。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish case is that activity already leads price and the seven-source fused acceleration is high, so weak relative performance may represent an early entry window rather than a lack of confirmation [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the thesis if subsequent readings show contracts, solicitations, grants, or material events turning meaningfully positive while relative strength improves from its current negative level [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if fused acceleration falls, lobbying weakens without broader sources improving, and news acceleration and relative strength remain negative [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: Current activity is moderately strong: material 8-K events are elevated at z=0.854, acceleration is 1.278, and two sources contribute, but congressional net buying is weak at z=0.095 [P3]. Durability is uncertain because the theme is only forming [P1]; acceleration supports persistence [P3], while the absence of a news leg removes an additional source of reinforcement [P5]. Continuity is weak: activity leads price by z=0.298 [P2], while 60-day relative performance is -4.35% and direction is neutral [P4]. That early divergence warrants monitoring rather than entry until activity persists or price begins to confirm across the covered retail group [P1][P6].
assessments.rationale_zh: 当前活动信号中等偏强：重大8-K事件读数为0.854，加速度为1.278，并有两个来源参与，但国会议员净买入仅为0.095 [P3]。持续性仍不确定，因为该主题尚处于形成阶段 [P1]；加速迹象支持后续延续 [P3]，但缺少新闻推动，少了一层佐证 [P5]。价格尚未确认：活动领先价格0.298 [P2]，过去60天相对大盘落后4.35%，方向仍为中性 [P4]。因此应继续观察，等待活动持续或相关零售公司股价开始响应 [P1][P6]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Retail companies are showing a pickup in material corporate filings, while buying by members of Congress remains only modest. Share prices have not followed: the group has trailed the market by about 4.4% over the past 60 days, and there is no supporting wave of news. Keep watching rather than buying now, and wait for the activity to persist or prices to begin responding.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 零售公司的重大公告活动正在增加，但国会议员的相关买入仍然较弱。股价尚未跟进，过去60天相关公司整体落后大盘约4.4%，同时也没有明显的新闻推动。现阶段更适合继续观察，等待这种活动持续或股价开始响应后再考虑买入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest case for entering now is that two activity sources are accelerating, material-event activity is elevated, and activity already leads price—exactly the setup in which price could catch up later [P2][P3].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Over the next update window, acceleration remains positive across both sources and 60-day relative strength improves from -4.35% toward or above zero [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The activity acceleration falls toward or below zero, support contracts to one source, or relative performance deteriorates further without a new news leg [P3][P4][P5].

rotation.summary: Leadership is rotating toward activity-led memory/storage, fintech, defense, semiconductor equipment, space, retail and communication services, while cybersecurity, energy, robotics, gold miners and AI agents remain confirmed but mature; crypto, broad AI/tech and health are fading or price-led.
rotation.summary_zh: 领导力正轮动至由真实活动领先的存储、金融科技、国防、半导体设备、航天、零售和通信服务；网络安全、能源、机器人、金矿及AI智能体虽获活动确认但已成熟，而加密资产、广义AI/科技与医疗正在衰退或仅由价格驱动。
